Class SpriteText

Namespace: osu.Framework.Graphics.Sprites
Assembly: osu.Framework.dll

A container for simple text rendering purposes. If more complex text rendering is required, use osu.Framework.Graphics.Containers.TextFlowContainer instead.

Truncate

If true, text should be truncated when it exceeds the osu.Framework.Graphics.Drawable.DrawWidth of this osu.Framework.Graphics.Sprites.SpriteText.

public bool Truncate { get; set; }

Property Value

bool

Remarks

Has no effect if no osu.Framework.Graphics.Sprites.SpriteText.Width or custom sizing is set. If enabled, osu.Framework.Graphics.Sprites.SpriteText.AllowMultiline will be disabled.

UseFullGlyphHeight

True if the osu.Framework.Graphics.Sprites.SpriteText's vertical size should be equal to osu.Framework.Graphics.Sprites.FontUsage.Size (the full height) or precisely the size of used characters. Set to false to allow better centering of individual characters/numerals/etc.

public bool UseFullGlyphHeight { get; set; }
